title: SSI Index — per-country config (NEW for Phase 1)
description: Per-country configuration carrying everything that was previously hardcoded in {country}/intelligence.html, {country}/index.html, etc. Single source of truth for: edition anchor, admin-level labels + counts, R3/R4/R6 bucket thresholds, DSO panel, deep-dive rotation. Read at runtime by the central renderer (Phase 2). Replaces the per-page hardcoded literals that caused KB §64.3 anti-patterns A2 (template double-render of admin levels), A5 (edition anchor in HTML), A7 (calibration thresholds hardcoded).

first_refresh.description: Inaugural edition publication date (YYYY-MM-DD). Drives Section G edition-anchor formula.

edition_anchor_month_offset.description: OPTIONAL: pre-computed offset for legacy compat. If absent, computed at render time from first_refresh as ((year-2026)*12 + month - 6).

admin.description: Administrative-level labeling. Replaces the {{NUTS-3 regions and {{NUTS-3 regions template double-render bug (KB §64.3 anti-pattern A2).

l2.description: Optional second admin level (e.g. France départements, Slovenia občine). OMIT for single-level countries to prevent template double-render.

thresholds.description: Calibration thresholds extracted from intelligence.html. Replaces hardcoded JS literals (KB §64.3 anti-pattern A7).

r3_buckets.description: R3_C_mult tier boundaries, computed per-country from the actual distribution. Ordered top-to-bottom (Capital-Intensive first).

high_consequence_threshold.description: R3_C_mult threshold for the 'High-Consequence Subs' KPI counter.

dso_panel.description: DSO list for dno-dashboard.html. Replaces hardcoded HTML cards.

deep_dive_rotation.description: Section G deep-dive topic rotation (intelligence.html). Replaces hardcoded JS array.

deep_dive.description: The current edition's featured deep-dive corridor for Section D of intelligence.html. Replaces hardcoded region literal + narrative text in slovenia/intelligence.html (KB §65.5 Phase 2c).

region.description: Region name as it appears in ssi-data.json substations[*].region (e.g. 'Savinjska').

label.description: Human-readable corridor label (e.g. 'Savinja Valley'). Defaults to `region` if absent.

narrative.description: Country-specific contextual paragraph appended to D.1 narrative.

ssi_metadata_extras.description: Country-specific overrides for ssi-metadata.js shape (e.g. R3 tier descriptor, R6 anchors, R7 ceiling).

regional_page.description: Per-country overrides for regional.html (Phase 2d.2 thin-shell). Replaces hardcoded JS literals such as the substation→region field name and the ranking-header suffix.

region_field.description: Substation-record field carrying the L1 region label (defaults to 'province').

fallback_region_field.description: Secondary substation-record field used when the primary field is empty (defaults to 'region').

ranking_label.description: Suffix used after the region count in the ranking header (e.g. 'NUTS-3 Regions · sorted worst → best').
